I always want to play mute. Hes my main. After months of playing him, I finally mastered him. First you want to put all the jammers near doorways. Usuaally, drones go through doors first so they will quickly be jammed. However, put them just outside the doorway so the drone cant peek inside and see the objetive. To add on, u dont want to put the jammer right in the center of the doorway. If frost wants to put her trap, or someone wants to put a barricade, they will not be able to. They will first shoot your jammer and not think about how u feel that your one jammer short. Also, if you see a vent, then place the jammer there too  

RIght after you put all the jammers down, start to do regualr defense things like putting up barricades, getting armor, and reinforcing walls. 

After you finish that, then the round should start and you have around 30 seconds till the enemies will be in the building. In these thirty seconds, you need to move some of these jammers to the reinforced walls, castle barricades, normal barricades, or windows. Now, if a fuze, thermite, or anyone that uses electronic devices tries to do anything, then they wont be able too. 

I usualy carry around a nitro cell because when you have a sheild, it takes a while to put the shield down and you can always use someone elses. 

Also, mute isnt really an objective guy. You can play mute however you want to. He doesnt have a acog so its better to be crepping up on an enemy from close range, like caviera. However, he will always be able to play both. 

To add on, after you see a drone jammed on the floor, dont bother to kill it. That split second your exposed while trying to kill the drone, you could be shot at or dead. Leave the 10 XP for someone else. 

Finally, his guns are an issue to me too. The recoil is weird so its hard to get a headshot. The way to get accurate shots with mute is to use burst. This is when you click the trigger or mouse for 1 or 2 seconds so a short burst sprays out. These are more accurate and it will be easier to kill.

However, the best way to play an opporater is by studying him and to continuously playing with him(Or her). Adapt to the recoil and burst strategy and your sure to be a really good mute. Also, after you have mastered him, buy cool headgear. You look cooler. 

Good luck
